name: gdrive-reader
description: Read-only access to one Google Drive folder: list it (with subfolders) and read its files, after signing in with Google OAuth.

folder_url.title: Drive folder URL
folder_url.description: The Google Drive folder this plugin reads. The default is the take-home test folder.

broker_url.title: Sign-in backend URL (self-host only)
broker_url.description: Leave empty to use the author's deployed backend. Set it to your own Worker URL when self-hosting.

client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID (self-host only)
client_id.description: Leave empty to use the author's OAuth client. Set it to your own Web client ID when self-hosting.

callback_port.title: Sign-in callback port (optional)
callback_port.description: Leave empty for a random port. Set a fixed port only when Claude Code runs over SSH and you forward that port.
